title: jackc/puddle v2
notes: puddle.NewPool with MaxSize 10 and a constructor that returns an empty resource; Acquire checks out, Release returns. Like deadpool, puddle creates each resource on first use, up to the maximum, in a goroutine of its own. The pool is closed at the end of the operation. One goroutine per caller, a WaitGroup to wait, runtime.Gosched() to yield; v2 is the current major version of the module.
